title: Eleven Consignments and One Unopened Crate
subtitle: 物资与分发 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 物资与分发（灾害防范·物资分发与调配）
meta: 主题语境：物资与分发（灾害防范·物资分发与调配）　|　核心词汇：distribution　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 distribution 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the storekeeper ① planned a distribution that no officer in the depot would have approved, and he said the planning was the whole of the relief. The ② distribution, meaning the handing out and not the spread, ran eleven consignments and stayed unrecorded in the book; a distribution, he said, is the only thing in a depot that is judged by how long it is left unentered.

Every ③ distribution in that depot had the same unopened crate at the back of it, and the ④ distribution at the end, meaning the one they kept for the winter villages and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever checked twice. A distribution, his clerk said, is nine parts counting and one part somebody willing to plan; the storekeeper said the counting is the part that fills eleven consignments.

The geographer meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the distribution was the whole of the map, meaning the spread and not the handing out. The ⑥ distribution, meaning the spread and not any of that, is the only thing on a map that everybody shades and nobody visits; distribution, she said, is either something you plan or the only word that means both a handing out and a spread. She said the spread is the part they remember.

By 1957 the ⑦ distribution had become a line in a return, and the return had become an argument about the unopened crate. The ⑧ distribution of the whole thing, the storekeeper wrote in January, was one depot and eleven consignments of counting; distribution, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to count. She said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ distribution I remember is the one at the end, which was completed in 1971 and is still described as the strangest in the depot. A ⑩ distribution, the clerk said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being checked; every distribution, she said, is a spread that has agreed to look like a handing out. She said the spread was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 分发；分配（指仓库里安排的那一次）
B. n. 分发（指那份发放行为本身，与那份分布相对）
C. 固定搭配：plan a distribution 筹划一次分发
D. n. 分发（指留给冬季村庄用的那一次）
E. n. 分发；分配（抽象总称，指一处仓库的全部发放）
F. n. 分发（指报表上写到、被列明的那一次）
G. n. 分布；分布情况（指地图上标出的分布范围）
H. n. 分布（抽象总称，指人人涂色却无人到访的那片）

items.q: planned a distribution that no officer in the depot would have approved
The distribution, meaning the handing out and not the spread
the distribution was the whole of the map
the distribution had become a line in a return
The distribution of the whole thing
A distribution, the clerk said in 1973

answers.why: plan a distribution 意为“筹划一次分发”，1948 年仓库管理员筹划了一次全仓库没有一位军官肯批准的分发。
distribution 意为“分发”，指那份发放行为本身而不是那份分布，它历经十一批物资而在账簿上没有记录。
distribution 意为“分发、分配”，指那处仓库里每一次分发，每一次后面都有同一只未开启的板条箱。
distribution 意为“分发”，指留给冬季村庄用的那一次，是唯一有人核对过两次的。
distribution 意为“分布、分布情况”，指地图上标出的分布范围，地理学家说这份分布就是那张地图的全部。
distribution 意为“分布”，指人人涂色却无人到访的那片而不是那份发放行为，是地图上人人都涂色、却无人到访的东西。
distribution 意为“分发”，指报表上写到、被列明的那一次，到 1957 年这次分发成了报表里的一行。
distribution 意为“分发、分配”，管理员一月写道，整件事的发放是一处仓库和十一批物资的清点。
distribution 意为“分发”，我记得的是末尾那一次，1971 年完成，至今仍被说成仓库里最奇的一次。
distribution 为抽象总称，书记员 1973 年说，一次分发是唯一会因为被核对而变得更好的东西。
